responsibility: Implements the front-end dispatcher for the gm2 ISO channel subsystem. It validates ChanId values, looks up each channel’s device table via RTio and IOLink, enforces required read/write/text/raw flag combinations, invokes device-specific procedure hooks stored in the DeviceTable, maintains per-channel read results, and raises the standard ChanExceptions and device diagnostics used by all higher-level I/O modules.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file contains the operational channel dispatcher: it aliases ChanId to RTio.ChanId, validates channels, fetches device tables through IOLink, calls per-device hooks, stores read results, and raises channel exceptions, whereas IOChan.def only defines the interface.
